nasa_as4.author: James R. Reeder

nasa_copv.title: A Compilation of Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessel Research (2015-2021)
nasa_copv.author: William Schonberg
nasa_copv.evidence: NASA contractor technical compilation; vessel construction identities are reported from underlying impact tests. This is not a complete elastic characterization. Table footnote c identifies liner strength values as MatWeb; those strength numbers are deliberately not imported.

convention.nu_ij: minus transverse strain in j divided by axial strain in i under uniaxial stress in i
convention.material_axes: 1=fiber; 2=in-plane transverse; 3=ply-normal. Must rotate into vessel frame/layup; meridian is not automatically fiber axis.
convention.future_geometry_basis: m=-unit tangent in increasing-z direction; c=+e_theta; n=outward; require det[m,c,n]=+1

elastic_control_candidate.use: Code/reference elastic verification only; not a validated manufactured COPV

liner.derivation_note: Isotropic mathematical closure explicitly assumed; G is derived, not separately measured in Table 4.
liner.temperature_note: Not specified alongside this property table; not silently assigned to a certified temperature point.
liner.heat_treatment: T6 designation; detailed processing/lot condition not given

checks.constitutive_validation_scope: Algebraic SPD and reciprocity only; not a constitutive FE patch test.

overwrap.conditioning_note: Table 1 has no explicit cure schedule or property-specific temperature. Report tests discuss ambient 77 F and hot/wet specimens, but that does not certify Table 1 at those conditions.
overwrap.provenance_note: Nine constants reported by the NASA benchmark table; E2=E3 etc are table entries. No additional transverse-isotropic closure imposed.
overwrap.transverse_isotropy_note: Do not replace reported G23 with E2/(2*(1+nu23)); the supplied rounded set is retained as orthotropic.

checks.constitutive_validation_scope: Algebraic SPD and reciprocity only; not a constitutive FE patch test.

real_copv_material_candidate.use: Traceable real COPV construction candidate; insufficient elasticity data to launch material-specific FE

liner.transfer_note: Generic NASA 6061 elastic input may be considered in a clearly declared study; it does not characterize the actual Phase A liner batch.

not_imported: COPV tensile strengths are not stiffness constants
Fiber-only Young modulus is not cured UD composite modulus
MatWeb-derived liner strength numbers from compilation are not treated as first-party measurements

next_freeze_requirements: Review benchmark source/units and report-only status
Obtain material-specific missing 3D constants for real COPV candidate or explicitly approve a modeling closure as an assumption
Constitutive rotation, energy and patch checks
Never silently fill missing constants from another carbon/epoxy material
